Welcome to the award-winning St George’s Veterinary Group

Whether it’s a friendly welcome, fuss and cuddles from our caring team or expert medical attention from our highly experienced vets and nurses, you and your pet can expect the highest quality care every time you see us. Because we know that only the best will do for your four-legged friend...

At St George’s, we love animals just as much as you do. So we’re dedicated to delivering exceptional levels of care and advice at all times, to help you and your pet enjoy the best possible life together. 

In addition to our state-of-the-art St George’s Hospital facilities in Wolverhampton, we have six branch surgeries – in Albrighton, Bushbury, Halesowen, Perton, Sedgley and Merry Hill – plus a dedicated equine clinic and our Vets 2 You mobile service that makes home visits to pets in the Stourbridge area.
